description: Verify that DUT's ARP Reply carries hw_addr_len == ETHERNET_ADDR_LEN (6) — must declare correct MAC-field width in the response, just as the Request did (RFC 826 §2.4)
approach:
[Objective]
Reply-side analogue of ARP_10 (which checks hw_addr_len=6 in DUT's own Request).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ARP Request (hw_addr_len=6, target_ip=DUT IP)

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: ARP Reply
      - hw_addr_len == 6 (ETHERNET_ADDR_LEN)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Reply's hw_addr_len equals 6.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_hw_addr_len_not_six — Reply emitted with hw_addr_len ≠ 6
• Fail_no_reply — DUT did not respond
